description: Ex-Royal Navy Sea Harrier FA.2, c/n 41H-912054/B48/P3, installed on the patio of The Driftwood restaurant by owner Ian Cotton, who trucked it in with the one-piece wing removed and reassembled it on site. Reported in 2025 as being offered for sale, so presence should be re-checked before a visit.
